## Summary

The bug was a one-line off-by-one in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:16`: `index()` passed `page: page + 1` to `Post.paginate()`, even though `page` (from `ListPostsQuerySchema`) already defaults to and validates as 1-indexed. This meant requesting page 1 actually fetched the ORM's page 2, permanently hiding the 10 newest posts from every page, and made the pager report the wrong current page. Fixed by passing `page` directly. Added a regression test suite in `tests/PostController.test.ts` (`posts.index pagination`) that seeds 25 posts via direct DB inserts (after `resetDatabase()` for a clean slate) and asserts that `/posts`, `/posts?page=1`, `?page=2`, and `?page=3` each return the correct 10/10/5 newest-first slice with accurate `pagination.meta` (currentPage, from/to, total, lastPage).
